title: Remove and refit the sealed stock shock
completeness: Complete assembled-bike access, removal, external inspection and refit of the same serviceable sealed stock shock, including fuel-system and body closure. No spring, bearing, seal or hydraulic/gas disassembly.

source.review_note: Shock PDF185/188/189/190/191 visually reviewed in this pass. Body/tank steps reused from the prior visually reviewed cold-valve guide; no valve steps copied. Mount seals/bearings remain undisturbed, so their disassembly/NEW renewal sequence is excluded.

applicability.included: Exact standard US2026 Yamaha YZ450F/YZ450FT stock sealed shock and stock body/tank/mount configuration

required_tools.name: Secure maintenance stand plus separate swingarm support
Calibrated torque wrench
required_tools.size: Accurate across4–56 N·m for touched joints

required_tools.name: Hand tools fitting actual stock body/tank and shock mounting fasteners
required_tools.size: Hex sizes not specified by source; do not infer from thread size

required_tools.name: Fuel-safe transfer pump, approved container, absorbent cloths and supplied fuel-joint covers
Clean bench and labeled hardware trays

renewal_policy: No scheduled new parts for this sealed-assembly removal/refit. If a mounting seal/bearing is disturbed or damaged, its separate OEM renewal/installation procedure must be completed; this guide does not authorize reusing removed NEW-marked seals.
preflight: Serviceable sealed shock; spring and mount seals/bearings stay assembled.
Fuel-handling equipment and specified grease ready.
critical_stop_conditions: Shock leakage, bent/damaged rod or worn/damaged mounting parts found.
Any mount seal or bearing must be removed.
Fuel contamination, damaged joint or connection that will not latch.

steps.title: Support the bike and swingarm
steps.instruction: Stop the engine and let the bike cool. Clean the work area and secure the bike on a maintenance stand with the rear wheel off the ground. Arrange separate support for the swingarm so it cannot fall when the lower shock bolt is removed. Keep fuel work away from ignition sources.
verification: Bike stable; rear wheel raised; swingarm support ready; fuel-handling tools ready.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Open the sub-seat
steps.instruction: Release its quick fastener and lift the sub-seat first; it is tethered to the main seat. Open the fuel cap and transfer the tank fuel with a fuel-safe pump into a suitable container, then secure the cap.
verification: Sub-seat tether not strained; fuel contained.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Remove access panels
steps.instruction: Remove the main-seat bolts and slide the seat rearward. Remove the left/right side covers, keeping their bolts and collars labeled. Slide the right cover out of its upper and lower locating slots instead of pulling the tabs apart.
verification: Seat and two side covers removed; hardware locations retained.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Expose the tank
steps.instruction: Release the air-filter-case cover ribs by pressing the duct sides inward and lifting the rear; slide the cover rearward to release the front projection. Leave the filter installed. Remove the left/right shroud bolts and shrouds, retaining their collars.
verification: Air-filter-case cover and shrouds removed; filter undisturbed.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Disconnect the tank
steps.instruction: Unplug the fuel-pump connector. Put cloths below and around the fuel-hose joint for residual pressure. Slide the connector cover back, press its two release buttons, and separate the joint by hand. Fit the supplied joint covers immediately to both openings.
verification: Pump disconnected; both fuel openings capped; no forced hose tools.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Lift the tank clear
steps.instruction: Remove the tank mounting fasteners, retaining the collars/dampers in their original locations, and lift the tank away. Support it so its weight does not rest on the fuel-pump mounting surface. Leave the pump installed in the tank.
verification: Tank supported; mounts accounted for; pump untouched.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Release the lower shock mount
steps.instruction: Identify the lower shock mounting bolt in the diagram. Support the swingarm and remove the lower mounting nut and bolt, keeping their hardware identified. Keep supporting the swingarm after the bolt is out; do not allow it to drop.
verification: Lower hardware retained and labeled; swingarm still supported.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Lift out the sealed shock
steps.instruction: Support the shock, remove its upper mounting nut and bolt, then remove the shock assembly. Retain the mount collars in their original positions. Leave the spring, preload nuts, guides, seals and bearings assembled. Keep the nitrogen valve and shock body closed, away from heat and damage.
verification: Shock supported on the bench; both mounts accounted for; sealed assembly and mount seals undisturbed.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Check the assembly before refitting
steps.instruction: Inspect the visible rod and body for bending, damage or leakage, and the spring, spring guides, mounting bearings and bolts for damage or wear. Record any defect. A damaged rod or leaking shock requires assembly replacement according to this manual; this removal/refit guide does not repair it. Do not refit a defective assembly as ready for use.
verification: Rod/body/spring/guides/mounts/hardware condition recorded; defects require separate repair or replacement.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Prepare the mounting bolts
steps.instruction: Clean the retained upper and lower shock bolts and apply molybdenum disulfide grease to their circumference and threaded portions. Keep the mounting seals, O-rings and bearings assembled; this step does not call for removing or greasing a bearing outer race.
verification: Upper and lower bolts greased with the specified molybdenum disulfide grease; no damaged mounting parts reused.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Refit the assembly
steps.instruction: Position and support the shock in its original orientation with the retained mount collars correctly seated. Install the upper bolt from the bike's right side. Raise the supported swingarm to align the lower mount, and install its bolt from the left side. Refit the corresponding mounting hardware without forcing misaligned parts.
verification: Upper bolt entered from right; lower from left; both mounting locations aligned; original hardware placement matched.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Tighten both shock mounts
steps.instruction: Tighten the upper shock mounting nut to 56 N·m and the lower shock mounting nut to 53 N·m. Record each result separately. These values apply to the shock mounts shown; the linkage fasteners remain untouched.
verification: Upper56 N·m and lower53 N·m recorded; both mounts secured.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Reconnect the fuel system
steps.instruction: Refit the tank on its retained dampers/collars. Tighten its two front mounting bolts to 8 N·m and the tank retaining screw to 4 N·m. Remove the temporary joint covers, push the fuel hose fully onto the pipe until it clicks, and slide the connector cover back into its locked position. Keep the hose holder correctly oriented, with no kink or pinch. Reconnect the pump plug.
verification: Tank front bolts8 N·m/retaining screw4 N·m; hose latched/covered/routed; pump plug connected.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Refit the panels and seat
steps.instruction: Locate the radiator-guard projections in the shroud holes, then install the shrouds at 7 N·m. Refit the air-filter-case cover by engaging its projection and both ribs. Slide side-cover tabs into their slots; the right-cover rib sits under the rear-fender rib. Tighten ordinary left/right side-cover bolts to 7 N·m and the two seat bolts to 13 N·m. Refit the sub-seat with its tether untwisted, then press, rotate and secure its quick fastener.
verification: Tabs/ribs seated; shrouds/side-cover bolts7 N·m; seat bolts13 N·m; quick fastener locked.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

steps.title: Close the job
steps.instruction: Restore fuel safely and secure the fuel cap. Check the fuel connection for leakage, the pump connector and body-panel seating, and account for tools and removed hardware. Confirm both shock mounts are secured before removing the separate swingarm support and lowering the bike from the stand. Record the removal/refit and any remaining fault; this job has not serviced the shock internals or changed spring preload.
verification: Fuel system closed without leaks; panels secured; both shock mounts complete; supports removed only after mounting closure; outstanding faults recorded.
steps.origin: original source-based summary; log/checklist prompts are application workflow

exclusions_detail: No pressure setting is provided: nitrogen circuit stays sealed.
No suspension oil amount is provided: hydraulic circuit stays sealed.
No claim that removal/refit fixes a handling fault.
No physical-bike QA or automatic ride-readiness approval.
